title: thick rubber backed carpet
text: thick rubber backed carpet. I am using these in a guest bathroom.  They are fairly thick and lux looking and feeling. They are rubber backed and washed (delicate - no spin) and dried (low tumble) well.  We'll see how they work long term.  I am a little concerned.. they came with separate rubber webbing pieces - even though they are rubber backed.  They seem to stay in place well... but  the bathroom is small.. vinyl flooring.  I am not sure why the rubber webbing pieces were included...  The color is a warm beige/tan... I have included some pics to show the pile and edging.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. I hope this info and the pics are helpful to you. I am committed to the honest, unbiased review process that makes Amazon such a great place to buy.

product_metadata.title: ITSOFT Non-Slip Bath Mat Water Absorbent Densely Woven Shaggy Soft Microfibers Bathroom Mat, 31 x 20 Inches Blue
features: Texture: Superfine fiber bath rug with especially soft and thick microfibers massaging your feet, relieving pressure and fatigue on your feet. Every time you step out of the shower or bathtub, you can enjoy superior comfort.
Fiber-locking: Unique fiber-locking technique, say goodbye to horrible fiber-dropping! 1.5 inches high fiber, give you soft touch experience.

Non-slip: The non-slip bottom is made of durable TPR material which has a bit heavy weight. This backing has practically slip resistance on the floor surface, that it won't slip or slide so as to keep you more safe and cozy. Place rug on dry and smooth floor only.

Great Absorbency: Microfiber absorbs water and dries quickly. Even after repeated use, alawys looking and feeling great. Floors stay dry after showers, so no more worries about slippery bathroom floors.
Low Maintenance: This bathroom mat is easy to clean and you can throw it into your washing machine without any worries about damaging it, neither color-fading nor fibre-dropping.
